R&S side needs a formal VNA source identifying the exact model, because the R&S ZNA specifications cover ZNA26, ZNA43, ZNA50 and ZNA67 in Version 24.00, April 2026 [63].
R&S side needs the exact frequency range, port count and relevant options, because the ZNA family ranges from 10 MHz up to 67 GHz and provides 2-port or 4-port base units [64].
R&S side needs the exact option set if citing TDR, time-domain, mmWave, noise figure, increased IF bandwidth or other capabilities, because the ZNA option table lists those capabilities by option code and dependencies [67].
Any R&S performance comparison must distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured or non-traceable data, because the source says typical, nominal, measured and non-traceable specifications are not guaranteed by Rohde & Schwarz [1].
Competitor side needs Keysight official or third-party evidence, because the existing R&S battle card descriptions of Keysight require Keysight official data or third-party verification [8].
Competitor side needs exact product model, option code, frequency range, calibration kit and test conditions, because the current Keysight ENA/PNA evidence does not list specific models, frequency ranges, option codes, calibration kit models or TDR option names [22][25].
Competitor side needs performance metrics from a formal source, because the current Keysight ENA/PNA pages do not provide measurement accuracy, dynamic range or bandwidth [22][25].
Semiconductor positioning needs evidence tying the specific VNA solution to the semiconductor use case, because the current battle-card claim only says Keysight has semiconductor market presence and key semiconductor accounts, while also requiring external verification [7][8].
The measurement application must be defined with DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration and de-embedding method, because existing high-speed interconnect cases list SoC, socket, connector and PCB contexts but note missing DUT, frequency, fixture, calibration or de-embedding details [13][82].
If comparing PCB or high-speed interconnect measurements, the evidence should include the measured items such as IL, TDR, DK/DF, impedance, return loss, roughness, crosstalk, TL modeling or eye diagram, because those are the items explicitly listed in R&S PCB test solutions [78].
If comparing against Keysight PCB-test positioning, the evidence should include the Keysight flow and tools only as stated: N1500A, ENA/PNA, PathWave ADS, Materials Measurement Suite, Delta-L software/probe and TDR probe in a high-frequency/high-speed PCB test flow [56].
That Keysight PCB-test evidence is not enough for a quantified comparison, because the source lacks test frequency, standard version, calibration method, fixture, probe model and instrument option code [55].
A solution-level comparison needs evidence for probes, mount kits, de-embedding tools and partners, because the documented R&S win pattern says the win factor is a total solution rather than a single instrument specification [14].
Claims about customer adoption, market share or production deployment need separate evidence, because the Keysight page does not infer market share, customers, shipments or deployment status for AI server, data center, PCB testing, wireless device testing or UXM [72].
Claims about a complete procurement list require a complete configuration source, because R&S PCB test solutions are not a formal solution catalog or complete purchasing configuration [77].
Claims about Delta-L, TDR or DK/DF performance require method and setup evidence, because current sources do not define Delta-L method, test standard, formula, coupon, probe model, software version or calibration procedure [58].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 與既有知識的關係
- 本來源補齊 [[R&S ZNA]] 主系列，與既有 [[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 形成關聯：[[R&S ZNA67EXT]] 是 1.0 mm Vector Network Analyzer System，量測範圍 10 MHz to 110 GHz；本來源的 [[R&S ZNA67]] 是 67 GHz base VNA 型號，並可透過 [[mmWave converter support]] 與 accessories 延伸應用。
- 本來源與既有 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[R&S FSWX]] 等 spectrum / phase-noise analyzer 頁面在 [[Spectrum analyzer mode]]、[[Phase noise]]、[[Noise figure measurement]] 等功能上有橫向關聯，但本來源屬於 VNA 產品規格，不應與市場或技術背景合併。
- [[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS 與既有其他產品頁的 [[Health and utilization monitoring service]] 有橫向關聯；本來源列出 SNMP、REST JSON、SCPI、device web 等 readout/display protocols。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S ZNA]] — Vector Network Analyzer 系列，涵蓋 26.5 GHz、43.5 GHz、50 GHz、67 GHz 型號。
- [[R&S ZNA26]] — 26.5 GHz 型號，3.5 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA43]] — 43.5 GHz 型號，2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA50]] — 50 GHz 型號，2.4 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[R&S ZNA67]] — 67 GHz 型號，1.85 mm ruggedized male connector。
- [[Vector Network Analyzer]]、[[Dynamic range]]、[[Measurement bandwidth]]、[[Direct source and receiver access]]、[[Noise figure measurement]]、[[mmWave converter support]]、[[Phase-coherent source control]]、[[Health and utilization monitoring service]]、[[Time domain analysis]]、[[Deembedding]]。

R&S ZNA › 文件依據
- 來源：[[ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400]]。
- 文件：R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications。
- 文件編號：PD 5215.4652.22。
- 文件版本：Version 24.00。
- 發布時間：April 2026。

R&S ZNA › Measurement speed
- Measurement speed 測試條件：firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)。
- Acquisition time per point：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog wideband 時 1 µs；30 MHz measurement bandwidth 時 32 ns。
- Linear frequency sweep 條件 201 points、10 GHz center frequency、200 MHz span：1 MHz measurement bandwidth、IF filter analog normal 時 time per sweep < 3.9 ms；sweep cycle time < 4.9 ms。
- IEC/IEEE VXI11 over 1 Gbit/s LAN：201 measurement points、800 MHz start frequency、1 GHz stop frequency、1 MHz measurement bandwidth 的 measurement and data transfer time 為 14 ms / 13 ms；201 measurement points magnitude 的 data transfer time 為 1.7 ms / 0.9 ms。
- Switching time between channels with a maximum of 2001 points：< 2 ms。
- Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNA › Key performance（Version 24.00）
- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。
- Power sweep range：100 dB typical continuous electronic sweep range；可使用 mechanical step attenuators 位移 sweep range。
- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
- Speed example：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。

- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

Option 表資料品質審查 › 核心問題
依 [[review-options]]，Option 表共有 `1535` 列，其中 `161` 列需要人工判斷，涵蓋 `26` 台儀器。這些問題不是產品規格本身的錯誤，而是從 datasheet / configuration guide 抽取成表格時產生的資料建模與資料品質問題。

主要類型：

1. **placeholder code 被抽成真實 code**  
   例如 `R&S®SMW-B10xx`、`R&S®ZNAXx-B161`、`R&S®SMAB-B1xx`、`R&S®SMM-B10xx`、`R&S®ZNAxx-B41`、`R&S®ZN-ZE1xx`。來源判斷這些多半是 datasheet 用 `xx` / `xxx` 表示任一系列型號或任一 frequency option 的佔位符，不應直接作為可報價 code。

2. **requires / excludes 欄位無法表達原文邏輯**  
   原文常見 `or`、`and`、model-dependent、path-dependent、quantity-dependent 條件，例如「`R&S®SMW-B13 or R&S®SMW-B13T`」、「`R&S®FSV3-K144 option or R&S®FSV3-K145 and R&S®FSV3-K148 options`」、「two or four installed options」。若表格只能填單一 code，會造成假缺漏或錯誤依賴。

3. **requires 指向表中不存在的 code**  
   [[review-options]] 多次指出 `SMW-B9/-B10`、`R&S®SMW-B13T`、`R&S®SMW-B13XT`、`R&S®FSWP-K60`、`R&S®FSWP-K70` 等被 requires 引用，但抽取表中沒有對應列。這通常代表 option table coverage gap，不代表正式 datasheet 沒有該 option。

4. **缺描述 code**  
   例如 `R&S®ZNA26-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA43-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA50-B16x`、`R&S®ZNA67-B16x`、`R&S®FSV3-B1000`、`R&S®FSV3-B600`、`R&S®NRP-Z8x`、`R&S®FS-SNS18` 等需要回查原文補描述。

5. **OCR / 表格抽取錯位**  
   [[R&S AREG800A]] frontends、system alignment options、[[R&S AREG8-K553]] 與 [[R&S QAT100]] 相鄰片段出現文字錯位風險；應回查原 PDF 或既有正式來源頁，不應用相鄰片段直接覆蓋產品頁。

這份來源是 **R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications**，文件編號 **PD 5215.4652.22**，**Version 24.00**，發布時間 **April 2026**，涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列與 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]] 四個型號。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。

Competitor side needs performance metrics from a formal source, because the current Keysight ENA/PNA pages do not provide measurement accuracy, dynamic range or bandwidth [22][25].
Semiconductor positioning needs evidence tying the specific VNA solution to the semiconductor use case, because the current battle-card claim only says Keysight has semiconductor market presence and key semiconductor accounts, while also requiring external verification [7][8].

Claims about a complete procurement list require a complete configuration source, because R&S PCB test solutions are not a formal solution catalog or complete purchasing configuration [77].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 **R&S®ZNA Vector Network Analyzer Specifications**，文件編號 **PD 5215.4652.22**，**Version 24.00**，發布時間 **April 2026**，涵蓋 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列與 [[R&S ZNA26]]、[[R&S ZNA43]]、[[R&S ZNA50]]、[[R&S ZNA67]] 四個型號。

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 重點摘要
- 型號頻率範圍：
  - [[R&S ZNA26]]：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA43]]：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz，可為 2.92 mm 或 2.4 mm ruggedized male test port connector。
  - [[R&S ZNA50]]：10 MHz to 50 GHz。
  - [[R&S ZNA67]]：10 MHz to 67 GHz。
- 各型號提供 2 ports 或 4 ports base unit；test port impedance 為 50 Ω，DC block 為 standard。
- Key performance 包含：dynamic range > 129 dB specification without options、147 dB typical with options、maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction；sensitivity > –120 dBm at 1 Hz IF bandwidth specification without options，並有 –162 dBm measured with options（1 kHz measurement bandwidth normalized to 1 Hz）。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；搭配 [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。
- Measurement speed 條件包含 firmware version 3.20、Windows 11 (64 bit)；例：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz、500 kHz measurement bandwidth、1601 points、2-port calibration 時 sweep time 96 ms nominal。
- 4-port instruments：最多 4 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 5 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，4-port model 總計 8 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- 2-port instruments：最多 2 sources，independently configurable、phase coherent、phase controlled；另有第 3 source 可作為 LO supply；每 port 有 2 true receivers，2-port model 總計 4 true receivers，無 multiplexing。
- Optional rear panel LO out 可支援 mmWave converters；4-port model 最多 4 個 converters，2-port model 最多 2 個 converters，無需 external signal generator；rear panel LO out typ. +25 dBm，最高 26.5 GHz。
- [[R&S ZNA-K28]] continuous data recording 支援 infinite data point capture、circular buffer，並可透過 LAN 或 USB 連續資料傳輸。
- [[R&S ZNA-B26]] direct IF access：IF input 可用於 mmWave converter 與 antenna measurement systems，bandwidth 1 GHz；IF output up to 2 GHz bandwidth 可用於 external pulse analysis。
